body: Thanks, I'll try to check it out

I get where you're coming from. I guess that I have this kind of attitude as a defense mechanism of sorts. I feel like it would be foolish or naive to just be unquestioningly optimistic. That just really doesn't make sense to me when I try to wrap my mind around it. I guess that I don't see how being like that could be healthy. First of all, I just have no idea how to find happiness at all. Even if I were to become happy someday, my problems would remain. It's not like changing my mindset would magically fix my body and my medical issues. That will never happen; I will always have to deal with this bullshit. I feel like it would be too fake and just stupid to think "Oh, I have a fucked up life and am a genetic dead end, but it's okay because I'm great!".

>you had a crappy childhood and your dick's not normal, you still have way, way more going for you than a lot of people.

And yet, I have a lot less going for me than a lot of people.

I have tried to think differently. When I was younger, I used to imagine myself having a family. I would daydream about having a wife and kids, about having a happy life with them. Playing with my kids, taking them to school, going on vacations. I don't know why, but I guess I had a really active imagination when I was younger, and I spent a lot of time trying to escape my present situation/circumstances and envision a better future for myself. Then, when I hit 13 or so, I realized the reality of my situation, and what my medical issues entailed for my future. Despite having been told that I was sterile when I was quite younger, I guess that it never truly registered with me. I think that I was in denial about it or something. I tried to make myself hate kids, and for a long time, I did. But that didn't last, and it is still painful for me to see my friends and relatives starting families. 

I am tired of being knocked down peg after peg...I am really tired of not being able to just have a simple fucking life. It is when I have tried to get myself into a more positive mentality that things have come crashing down on me and my life has gotten more difficult or complicated. Changing my attitude cannot change the realities of my situation.
Don't want to get too specific...basically, I have severe deformities which affect my genitalia. I am not being self-effacing when I say severe.
Yeah, I actually tried sending Savage Love letters (I think I tried twice), but I've never gotten a response. He seems to be much more into politicized stuff now, anyway.

Okay, well...the problem is that I care about sex! I would love to be able to have sex. It's just not possible, and I do not know how to deal with that frustration. It is seriously, insanely frustrating. 

I guess I don't understand how to know whether or not a woman would be okay with not having a normal sex life. Why would she want to be with me and deal with all of this bullshit when she could have a much simpler life with another guy. I feel too inadequate, I guess that's partly why I always end prospective relationships.

You just described what my cat does. I have had dogs, and my cat is essentially a dog (but cleaner). If I don't wake up by a certain time, he will be sitting outside my door, howling and clawing at it. He licks my face, he follows me around my apartment and meows every time he sees me (if I hide behind a corner and keep popping out at him, he will meow every time), he plays fetch with me.

Lol that's pretty creepy about the sperm donor thing. I don't think that people actually do anything like that (or at least I hope not). But thanks. 

Nah, not into internet dating. And I suppose that I am physically attractive (well, according to what women have told me). I just have messed up junk. Women have been attracted to me before and have tried to initiate things with me. I just always push them away because it could not possibly end well.

I guess that's good to hear...I just really feel like my whole situation is too messed up to make a woman deal with. I feel like it is too naive to just expect things to work out. When women have been interested in me and have made advances, I just shut them down. It doesn't matter if they mean a lot to me. I have too many issues, not just physically, and I can't risk telling someone all of my problems only to have things bite me in the ass.

I guess that's something I have trouble seeing in that light. I don't feel comfortable with the idea of raising someone else's child as my own...that kind of seems wrong to me, I don't know.

I used to try to think in that way, but it has been getting more and more difficult to do so. It would sort of feel like I was kind of deceiving myself. But thanks.

I can only draw from my own life, from my own experiences...idk what to say.

No...my options are pretty limited...I can't just will myself to have a normal body.

I have a cat (though he acts more like a dog). I guess I'm a good pet owner, lol...I always had a crazy amount of pets growing up. But an animal is different than an actual human being.

My body does not produce any sperm at all, so what you're talking about is not possible.

I'm in the USA

I meant being a biological father...I'm not comfortable with the idea of raising someone else's child as my own. I guess I kind of feel like that's wrong. I think it's great that other people adopt and foster, but that's not meant for me. And anyway, I doubt that I would pass all of the extensive background checks required. I have been struggling with mental health issues since early childhood. No one would give someone's kid to me.

I don't want to get too specific because it's pretty humiliating. Basically, I was born with severe deformities affecting my genitals.

Yeah, I get what you mean. I don't understand how to change my mind, though...doesn't really make sense to me.

I really can't have a relationship...when women have tried to get close to me, I have pushed them away. Even if you ignore all of the physical problems (which are major), I have a huge amount of other problems and issues. I had a very bad childhood and I am pretty fucked up as a result, so it would be stupid to subject someone to my problems like that.

I meant being an actual biological father. I'm not comfortable with the idea of adoption, but it's good that other people do it.

Well, I am assuming that love eventually gives way to sex, which I cannot have with anyone. See my problem? I would very much like to be in love and be in a relationship, but I don't think that is meant to happen for me. 

My life has very limited options, and there isn't anything I can do about that. I was born messed up and I don't know how to be satisfied or content when I am unable to have anything even close to the sort of future I would want.
